title: What the independent regional efficiency review counted
question: Which cost reductions were already reported and which actions still needed verification?
finding: The Phase One review attributed $516 million in cumulative operating cost savings to BART and more than $76 million to Caltrain from July 2019 through June 2025. That was about 9% and 7% of their respective operating costs on the report’s basis.
how: Use the committee’s fiscal-period comparison and agency-specific examples. The review covered service adjustments, hiring controls, lower overtime and other operating changes. A reduction can include spending an agency avoided.
limits: The review relied in part on agency-reported estimates. These amounts cannot be counted as cash recovered from wrongdoing or added to the inspector general’s settlements. The committee’s later Phase Two work was prospective.

sources.t: Independent Oversight Committee, Phase One Financial Efficiency Review, BART and Caltrain sections
